```{=html}

  </div>
  <div class="selector-label">Data</div>
  <div class="selector-options" data-choice="tech" role="group" aria-label="Data">
    <button type="button" data-value="visium">Visium</button>

    <button type="button" data-value="hd-cells">Visium HD (cells)</button>

  </div>
</div>
```
